faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to see results?
faq.a1: For a simple web or product, we can show you parts of the process from week one, depending on our team's workload. For mid-sized projects, results appear in the first 2–4 weeks; for larger ones, 6–8 weeks.
faq.q2: Do I need to change my current tools?
faq.a2: No. We integrate with what you already use (Excel, SAP, HubSpot, Notion, whatever). No painful migration. We connect, not replace.
faq.q3: What if my team isn't technical?
faq.a3: Everything we build comes with a simple interface and training included. If they can use WhatsApp, they can use our software.
faq.a4: It depends on scope. The initial consultation is free and we give you a fixed quote before we start. No surprises, no hidden costs.
faq.a5: Continuous support + optimization. We don't disappear after deploy. We monitor, iterate and scale with you.
